baby:4.sourceText: Lately the baby seems to think eleven at night is morning.

corridor:3.sourceText: Being thirty-two weeks pregnant does not mean made of glass.

corridor:4.sourceText: It means you're carrying something considerably more important than this laboratory.

power:0.sourceText: Warning. array power above standby threshold.

power:1.sourceText: Control, this is Bennett. Shut down power to TOMBS.

power:2.sourceText: Jack, we were about to call you. We're seeing a massive draw from your building.

power:7.speaker: sarah
power:7.sourceText: Yesterday's full test didn't use half that.

disconnect:0.sourceText: Possible network intrusion. Cut external access to the laboratory and disconnect TOMBS from the island grid.

reactor:4.sourceText: Then where is it getting the power?

shutdown:0.sourceText: Then we'll do it the old-fashioned way.

boundary:5.sourceText: That can't be right. That's kilometers.

map:1.sourceText: No. The array can't do this.

shelter:5.speaker: jack
shelter:5.sourceText: Change that order. Tell everyone to get indoors and away from exterior walls. Nobody leaves the developed zone until we understand what this thing is doing.

overload:2.speaker: sarah
overload:2.sourceText: Maybe good, or maybe everyone-inside-the-field-dies bad?

manual:2.speaker: jack
manual:2.sourceText: Come on. Give me manual control!

manual:4.speaker: sarah
manual:4.sourceText: I'll try to interrupt the calculation.

recovery:2.speaker: sarah
recovery:2.sourceText: I'm here. I don't think so.

sensors:6.speaker: jack
sensors:6.sourceText: Which means something is very wrong.

lena:4.sourceText: We've got power. Most systems are responding, but communications are down.

lena:6.speaker: lena
lena:6.sourceText: External. We can't reach anything beyond the settlement.

lab:wake:0.sourceText: It was March fifth, in the year twenty-one ten.

lab:wake:1.speaker: narrator
lab:wake:1.sourceText: It was almost eleven at night on a remote island somewhere in the Atlantic Ocean. The island stretched roughly fifty-six kilometers across, about thirty-five miles from one side to the other, but most of it remained undeveloped wilderness. Near its center sat a research settlement of laboratories, homes, workshops, medical facilities, and other buildings supporting the nearly five hundred people who lived there.

lab:wake:2.speaker: narrator
lab:wake:2.sourceText: Deep inside one of those laboratories, Dr. Jack Bennett was hard at work. Technically.

lab:trace:0.speaker: jack
lab:trace:0.sourceText: Come on. What are you doing?

lab:trace:1.sourceText: An unfamiliar connection appeared for half a second and vanished.

lab:lock:1.speaker: narrator
lab:lock:1.sourceText: He immediately locked the terminal. The screen went black for three seconds, then came back on and reopened the same directory.

lab:call:12.speaker: narrator
lab:call:12.sourceText: Jack released the intercom and looked back at the monitor. The TOMBS directory was still open.

lab:call:14.speaker: narrator
lab:call:14.sourceText: The cursor moved without him touching anything.

lab:arrive:0.sourceText: Please tell me you didn't break something.

lab:arrive:2.sourceText: You called me in here to admit that?

lab:arrive:13.speaker: jack
lab:arrive:13.sourceText: I got an unauthorized access warning. I checked the network monitor and saw a connection I didn't recognize, but it disappeared before I could trace it.

lab:logs:0.sourceText: She pulled another chair beside him and nudged his out of the way.

lab:logs:5.speaker: narrator
lab:logs:5.sourceText: Jack rolled sideways to give her room.

lab:baby:3.sourceText: No. You're the one I found asleep at a laboratory terminal.
